class.name: ECSQuery
class.brief_description: Declarative filtering engine for identifying relevant entity sets.
class.description:
[ECSQuery] provides a fluent, high-performance interface for searching the ECS world. It allows you to build complex filters based on component Archetypes (composition). Queries use an internal bitmask system that allows for O(1) matching against billions of archetype combinations. Once built, a query can be executed repeatedly to retrieve a fresh set of matching entity IDs. [b]Usage Pattern:[/b] [codeblock] var query = EntityManager.get_singleton().create_query() .with_component("TransformComponent") .with_component("HealthComponent") .without_component("InvisibleComponent")
var results = query.execute() for id in results: # Process entity... [/codeblock] [b]Tip:[/b] Queries are [RefCounted]. You should store and reuse query objects in your systems rather than creating new ones every frame to save on allocation overhead.

method.name: with_component
method.description: Adds a [b]Required[/b] constraint to the filter. The query will only return entities that possess this component type.

method.name: without_component
method.description: Adds an [b]Exclusion[/b] constraint to the filter. The query will skip any entity that possesses this component type.

method.name: execute
method.description: Performs the search across all active entity registries. Returns an array of entity IDs that satisfy all defined constraints. [b]Note:[/b] This operation involves a parallel scan of the archetype tables. While fast, for very complex filters or massive worlds, it is best called at the start of a system's update cycle.
